assumptions.statement: D2 freezes causal interfaces and admissible operator properties, not final numerical constitutive equations or parameters.

The retained representation read at beat k may condition current at k; declared current or downstream consequences may write the retained representation for k+1; same-beat use of the new value requires a later D6 implicit-closure decision.
A and B carry nonresource structural information; C projects the existing C resource. No admitted D2 candidate carries an independent physical resource.
D2 defines fixed-stratum lifecycle semantics and topology-event obligations; D4 and D9 still own concrete interspace transport and parity.

terminology.write: declared transition from the beat-k representation and admitted inputs to the beat-k-plus-1 representation
